description: Open one page and read data from it without changing anything on it. Returns the data, shaped by result_schema when given. Use run_task instead when getting to the data takes clicking, typing or several pages. If reading is still going when the call returns, the reply has status "running" and a task_id: call get_task with it.

effort.description: How much capability to spend. Default medium; raise it for hard pages, lower it for simple ones.

prompt.description: What to read from the page, e.g. "every listing with its title, price and link".

result_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the shape of the data to return, for example {"type":"object","properties":{"price":{"type":"number"}},"required":["price"]}. Omit it for a free-form answer.

show_browser.description: Show the browser window while the task runs. Default false unless the server was started with --headed.

url.description: The page to read (http or https).

use_proxy.description: Route the browser through the proxy configured in this server's environment. Default false.

name: retrieve_data
title: Read data from a page
